services.desc: Salt Lake City - Unified Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Academy has been teaching Brazilian Jiu Jitsu for over twenty years in Salt Lake City. Established by five Pedro Sauer black belts Unified Brazilian Jiu Jitsu was among the original pioneers of the Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu scene in the greater Salt Lake City Area. Led by black belt Instructors, John Carlquist and James Gardner who have over 50 years of combined training and teaching experience, Unified Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Academy’s style of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu is based on highly effective self-defense techniques that can be applied in real-world scenarios and in a competition environment.
